evidence.reason: The rejection path accepts any non-null object with a `sessionId` property and passes it to `reapFresh`, which removes that id via `SessionStore.remove` whenever the invocation is fresh and the id is a string. There is no check that the error is a supported fresh-session rejection such as `SessionBoundError`, nor that the id belongs to a record this run created. A driver or injected provider rejection carrying an arbitrary `sessionId` before record creation can therefore delete an existing session, contradicting the wrapper’s documented ownership guarantee.
